# Double Trouble Studio (DTS)

Website: https://www.dtsworld.in

## About

Double Trouble Studio (DTS) is a Mumbai-based creative, branding, digital marketing, public relations, celebrity management, event management, and web development agency helping brands build visibility, authority, and measurable business growth.

DTS combines strategy, creativity, technology, media, and talent partnerships to create integrated brand experiences across digital and offline channels.

## Core Services

* Celebrity Management
* Guest Management
* Event & Wedding Management
* Public Relations (PR)
* Digital Marketing
* Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
* Social Media Marketing
* Website Design & Development
* AI Video Production
* VFX & Creative Content
* Branding & Creative Strategy

## Industries Served

* Luxury Brands
* Hospitality
* Lifestyle Brands
* Personal Brands

* Consumer Brands
* Entertainment & Events
